test_vectors.coverage: Empty streams, every ASCII byte including NUL and DEL, seven-byte chunks, idempotent finish, and unchanged finalized states rejecting empty, valid, and malformed chunks.

All ordered three-chunk partitions including empty chunks for UTF-8 width boundaries, U+D7FF, U+E000, noncharacters, U+10000, U+10FFFF, mixed-width text, BOM, combining marks, replacement characters, emoji joiners, and literal JSON escape text.
Pending prefixes of lengths one, two, and three; exact accepted-byte and completed-scalar counters; empty chunk identity; one-time scalar completion.
A three-byte pending prefix completes before a new one-byte pending prefix; all unused carry bytes are zeroed.

Isolated continuation bytes, illegal leaders, overlong encodings, surrogates, values above U+10FFFF, obsolete five-byte encodings, bad continuations, truncation, and absolute first-error offsets across all three-chunk partitions.
E0 9F, ED A0, F0 8F, and F4 90 fail immediately both within a chunk and across a chunk boundary.
Seven invalid continuation replacements at every continuation position in two-, three-, and four-byte sequences, across all three-chunk partitions.
Every proper prefix of representative multibyte sequences fails at its original absolute start on finish, preserving accepted state and saving a sticky error.
Rollback of counters, pending storage, and ASCII status when malformed input follows valid new bytes or a completed incoming prefix.
Zero, unit, and full-width scanner quote and escape carry remain unchanged during pending-prefix processing, successful finish, and malformed-input failure.
Reset clears counters, pending storage, scanner carry, failure, and finished status after successful finish, chunk failure, pending input, and finish failure.

Seeded private counters exercise exact u32::MAX byte and scalar totals, empty input at the limit, cumulative overflow precedence over malformed input, sticky overflow errors, and finalized-state precedence.

Seeded private counters exercise four-byte completion at the ABI limit, truncation and malformed-carry offsets near the limit, transactional pending-state overflow, and invalid input at offset u32::MAX - 1.
All 256 single-byte inputs across every three-chunk partition and all 65536 two-byte inputs split between bytes, compared against core UTF-8 validity and first-error offsets.
Eight starting alignments, scalar starts around 64- and 128-byte boundaries, each internal scalar split, 64-byte chunks, and invalid terminal continuation substitutions.
Ten deterministic replacements at every position in 80 bytes of mixed-width text, testing complete and truncated slices with splits around each mutation.
